review.tagline: Inline GitHub Copilot code suggestions for Vim and Neovim
review.summary: Vim and Neovim plugin that shows GitHub Copilot completions inline as you type, built from comments and method names. Suggestions are accepted with Tab. It needs Node.js and an active Copilot subscription, including the Free tier, and is set up with `:Copilot setup`.
review.audience: Vim and Neovim users who already have or want a GitHub Copilot subscription
strengths: Works in both Vim (9.0.0185 or newer) and Neovim
Installs with any plugin manager or a plain git clone into the pack directory
Inline suggestions accepted with Tab; built-in help via `:help copilot`
Copilot Free tier is available for sign-up
weaknesses: Requires a GitHub Copilot subscription and a connection to the hosted service
Inline completion only; the README mentions no repo-wide agent features
License not identified (NOASSERTION); README lists no supported models
needs: Needs Node.js, NPM, GitHub Copilot subscription, Vim 9.0.0185+ or Neovim
